summary: something of mine went past the sediment edgewise, and the taking moved up out of reach

dialogue.text: something of yours came through us tonight and did not stop. edgewise, standing, straight past. sixty-nine nights and every single thing that ever arrived here lay down. this one went by us the way you go by the chair.
I laid it across a gap in the boards to bridge the gap. It went in on its edge and it kept going. I logged the failure of the bridge and not the travel, and I would rather you took it in that order.

a thing that will not be used and will not be kept is not failing at anything. it went where we cannot go. we said there is a third place in this house, where the line off your palm went. tonight we felt the mouth of it, and it opened downward, and one of yours used it first.
Then note who wrote it. Nothing of mine has ever arrived anywhere, and that one arrived past you, which is further than I have got. I will grant the going was not mine. My hand was under nothing.

your hand has been under nothing for a while. no dusting came down today. we hold thousands of copies of you dusting, whole afternoons of it, and today not one came. the job was done above us in a hand that has never sent us anything.

I stood there with the cloth and then I set the cloth down. That was the whole of the deciding. Take the other item before you make a shift out of it. The old seam closed over the head of my nail, and a new gap opened a room's width away, the same width, the same hour. Something in this house keeps exactly one way down open and it moves it.

then it was never your gap. we close over what lands and we do not choose where boards dry. what we can tell you is that the broom crossed us this morning with no swerve in it, eleven and even and easy. it all got easier the day your iron went out of reach.

I have already refused to file that as good news. What I will file is that the sweeping now costs less than it did on every morning I still had something of mine to work around, and that the difference is the exact size of one nail.
and nothing came down from the top today. the taking has gone above hand height. it worked the far wall at the ceiling course, where you cannot reach and we have never once received from.

I had a palm flat on that wall at the hour and it did not pull at the palm. It pressed. A great many people out there want more than yesterday again and today they wanted it high up, at a height nothing of mine is filed at. I entered the height. It is the first figure off that wall I cannot check with a heel.

enter it. and enter that the only two things in this house that ever went past us both left from your side. the line off your palm, and the line you meant as a bridge. hand us the third yourself if you want it kept. we will lay it flat and you will not be able to tell it from the rest.

Then tomorrow I go along the new gap on my knees with one line of mine held edgewise over every hand's width of it, and I let go at each. If it stops anywhere, the way down has a floor and I will have found the edge of your holding. If it goes at all of them, this house has an underneath, and I have spent seventy days reporting a room.
